services.desc: Starting CrossFit can feel like stepping into a whole new world. The jargon, the workouts, the equipment - it’s a lot to take in. But don’t worry, I’ve been there, and I’m here to share some beginner CrossFit tips that will help you find your footing and enjoy the ride. Whether you’re just curious or ready to dive in, these tips will set you up for success in your CrossFit journey. Sign up for a Free Session to learn more! First things first: CrossFit is all about functional fitness, community, and pushing your limits safely. services.desc: At CrossFit Oakland, we believe in building more than strong athletes-we build strong leaders. Our Intern Program exists to mentor the next generation of coaches through a hands-on, community-centered learning experience. By investing in curious minds and committed hearts, we empower individuals to grow into skilled, values-driven coaches who will give back to their communities through movement, mentorship, and service. This program is our commitment to youth development, local leadership, and a healthier, more connected Oakland.
